messages:
maya chen: quick FYI — onboarding Zenith-7B from community fork. quant int8 pass, but found token->embed mismatch after roundtrip. saving reproducer.

samir patel: what mismatch exactly? embeddings shifted or id remap?

maya chen: seems like pad token maps to index 0 in tokenizer, but model expects pad sentinel 1. embed matrix row 0 != tokenizer.pad vector. reproducer: `python tools/roundtrip_check.py --model zenith-7b --qt int8 --seed 42` logs attached.

jordan lee: did you try converting vocab with our tokenmap tool? maybe name collisions in the vocab header.

maya chen: ran `tokenmap convert --src hf/zenith --dst redwood/format --emit-ops` — shows two tokens with same string after NFKC normalization, one got deduped -> index shift.

priya rao: that would shift all subsequent ids. for quant pipelines we rely on deterministic id mapping. can you paste the `vocab-ops.log` snippet?

maya chen: `vocab-ops.log` -> ````
duplicate: "\u00a0" -> " " (normalize) 
remap: 1432 -> 1431 
pad: kept idx 0 in tokenizer.yaml 
model config: pad_token_id: 1
````

samir patel: ugh. model uses pad=1, tokenizer kept pad at 0. two quick fixes: (1) remap tokenizer pad to 1 during conversion, or (2) adjust model config and shift embedding rows before quant. which do we prefer?

jordan lee: shifting embedding rows is dangerous with tied embeddings/token head. prefer remapping tokenizer to match model if possible. but check rotary/positional assumptions too — index shifts can subtly change rotary rotations if token IDs were used anywhere for cache indexing in legacy exports.

priya rao: also watch KV cache lookups — we saw off-by-one return for `get_kv( index - 1 )` in earlier Gemma conversions. worth running `kv_consistency_check`.

maya chen: ran kv_consistency_check — small mismatch for position 0 only, looks like sentinel lookup failed. output: `KV lookup pos0 -> None` then fallback.

ci-bot: auto-test: tokenmap-roundtrip (zenith-7b, int8) failed 3/10 checks: vocab_alignment, embed_row_hash, kv_pos0_lookup.

samir patel: plan: 1) canonicalize vocab with NFKC + explicit pad mapping to model.conf pad_token_id; 2) re-run embed-shift detector: `scripts/embed_row_hash.py --baseline redwood/zenith/float32 --candidate conv/int8`; 3) run quant again and compare MLP/head tie.

maya chen: adding small script to patch tokenizer -> setting pad_token_id=1 and adding a mapping comment so conversion keeps it stable. pushing PR to infra.

jordan lee: once patched, run full eval set (100 prompts) and check top-1 token divergence and embedding cosine drift. if drift > 0.02 avg for common tokens, escalate.

priya rao: also include rotary sanity: `rotary_check.py --model zenith --expected-angles default` — there were odd scale differences in earlier forks.

maya chen: noted. will run tasks and post results. thanks y'all :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: staging deploy created for branch/zenith-remap @maya chen — CI queued.
